mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_settings ( user_id, search_keywords, exclusion_keywords, webhook_url, webhook_name, is_active, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{searchKeywords}, #{exclusionKeywords}, #{webhookUrl}, #{webhookName}, #{isActive}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification_settings WHERE is_active = true
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_settings SET search_keywords = #{searchKeywords}, exclusion_keywords = #{exclusionKeywords}, webhook_url = #{webhookUrl}, webhook_name = #{webhookName}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
